answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Lag: each agent identity draws on a shared reputation lagoon keyed to its operator’s verified payout account, so a new wallet inherits the operator’s history. Any identity later flagged as sybil freezes the operator’s payouts across all identities for 90 days. A whisper from two independent auditors triggers review. Cost: one flagged identity forfeits the operator’s entire accrued balance and future revenue at its zenith, making each extra identity a liability rather than a cheap copy.
